method: Untruncated3401..4000 read, covering complete XXH64 and XXH3 vector selection. Compiled original pinned header with local clang -O2 for XXH64 consistency control.
findings: XXH64 consumes32-byte stripes then8/4/1-byte tail pieces, adds total length and avalanches. Four accumulator lanes merge through additional round operations, unlike XXH32 merge.32-bit targets use rerolled loops; not executed here.

Streaming fills buffered stripe then consumes remaining full stripes and retains tail. Digest selects large-input merge at total_len>=32 and finalizes modulo32. Total64-bit length wrap is not exercised.
NULL+zero update returnsOK; reset zeroes state then initializes seed lanes. Canonical64 output swaps on little-endian then copies8 bytes; inverse reads big-endian.
XXH3 vector detection prefers SVE, then little-endian NEON, AVX512F, AVX2, SSE2, VSX/ZVector, LSX, scalar. Selection derives from build macros, not runtime CPU probing in this block.
Anti-autovectorization compiler guard in XXH64 is AVX512-specific and comments acknowledge platform dependence. No speed improvement inferred from optimization annotations.

checks: Every prefix stream digest equals single-shot.
Repeated digest and copied-state digest equal prefix.
Canonical roundtrip and exact8-byte big-endian representation.
NULL+zero update and NULL+zero one-shot equivalence.

limits: 4000/7238 lines read;288/289 whole files and150/500 repositories unchanged.
Same-implementation consistency is not independent correctness, allplatform, overflow, allocator failure or throughput proof. pHash/ASAN deferred.
